recommendation.bottom_line: Transfer Martinez → Tzolakis immediately (Martinez has left Villa for Chelsea and is no longer an FPL asset for Villa); captain Bruno Fernandes on the back of a 23-point GW2 haul against a winnable Everton away fixture.

transfer.rationale: Martinez has departed Aston Villa for Chelsea mid-season and is no longer the Villa GK — he is now functionally worthless as a Villa FPL asset. Zion Suzuki has taken over. This transfer is structurally forced. Tzolakis is the consensus replacement across all four profiles (differential, aggressive, conservative, template all name him): 26 FPL points in GW1–3 including a clean sheet vs Man United, priced at £4.6m with £1.1m banked after the deal. Hull's GW4 fixture is home vs Aston Villa — a winnable clean sheet chance for a newly promoted side already proving defensively solid. The optimizer disagrees, suggesting De Cuyper → Ajayi instead, which both leaves the GK black hole open AND strips a captain option from the squad. The optimizer's pure points-per-value signal on Ajayi is real (20pts at £4.1m = best ratio in Hull), but it ignores the structural urgency of replacing a broken GK slot. The four profiles unanimously override here — that is the stronger signal.

chip.rationale: All four profiles return null for chips this week. With a 139-point deficit vs the rival, chips should be saved for a double gameweek or a week with a transformational fixture swing — GW4 is not that week. No chip meets threshold.

captain.rationale: Bruno is in the form of his life — 23 FPL points (3 goals, 1 assist) in GW2 vs Ipswich, the season's top-scoring midfield output so far. He travels to Everton in GW4: a side that has started poorly and concedes chances against mobile attacking midfielders. Bruno holds penalties, direct free-kicks, and corners for United — maximum ceiling for a captain. João Pedro (equal EV at 1.14) is the competing option, but ESPN/Chelsea FC confirmed he missed GW3 vs Brighton with a lingering injury; his availability for GW4 is not confirmed, introducing meaningful start risk. De Cuyper (also 1.14 EV) has rotation risk at Brighton given Kadioglu competition and projects only 1.8 points per FPL Tactics model — the EV overstates his realistic ceiling. Bruno is the clear captain on form, fixture, and availability grounds.

watch_outs: João Pedro (Chelsea, FWD): missed GW3 vs Brighton with a thigh/lingering injury — start availability for GW4 unconfirmed as of deadline; do not captain without a clean bill of health.
De Cuyper (Brighton, DEF): rotation risk from Kadioglu at LB; also being played out of position on the wing due to Minteh injury — role could shift back once Minteh returns.

Ajayi (Hull, DEF): hamstring injury history (two separate hamstring issues in 2025-26 season per Soccerway) makes him a fitness risk despite elite early-season form; optimizer's pick but fragility is a real concern.
Martinez (now Chelsea GK): completely removed from Villa's FPL picture — Zion Suzuki is Villa's new No.1; any Martinez FPL points going forward are as a Chelsea substitute bench option at best.
